name: moph.gov.af
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But plain http serves the site without redirecting.
lesson: Redirect every http request to https with one permanent 301, then add HSTS.
summary: moph.gov.af scores 48 out of 100 (F). 10 checks fail now, 37 are at risk, and 19 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: Plain http serves the site without redirecting
fix.evidence: http:// answered 200. Visitors who type the address stay unencrypted.
fix.fix: Redirect every http request to https with a 301, then add HSTS.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 110 elements on /, /dr, /en, for example nav > .container > .navbar-brand[href="https://moph.gov.af/dr"][title="Home"] > .brand-text > p > b and a[href="[address hidden]"]. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

fix.title: Links must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 86 elements on /, /dr, /en, for example .section-striped:nth-child(4) > .container > .row > .col-lg-4:nth-child(1) > .card > .card-header > .card-img-top[alt="m and .section-striped:nth-child(4) > .container > .row >…
fix.fix: Give each link text, or an aria-label when it only holds an icon.

fix.title: All touch targets must be 24px large, or leave sufficient space
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 47 elements on /, /dr, /en, for example .section-striped:nth-child(7) > .container > .card-swiper > .swiper-pagination.swiper-pagination-clickable.swiper-pagina and .section-striped:nth-child(7) > .container > .card-swiper >…
fix.fix: Make tap targets at least 24 by 24 px, or leave that much space around them.

fix.title: 4 front-end libraries have known flaws
fix.evidence: swiper 4.3.0 (banner of /sites/default/files/js/js_cvYR2hGi-F9g6nHcEm6toLiAXp0D8BbSO080Ieht8DA.js): 1 known flaw, the worst rated critical, such as CVE-2021-23370. Versions of the package swiper before 6.5.1 are susceptible to prototype pollution. Bootstrap…
fix.fix: Upgrade swiper to 6.5.1 or later; upgrade Bootstrap to 4.3.1 or later; upgrade jQuery UI to 1.13.2 or later; upgrade jQuery to 3.5.0 or later. A major upgrade changes behavior, so retest the pages that use it.
